subject: Top-up request: POC load testing (Veridian)
messages:
From: Jamal Khan <jamal@veridian.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Top-up request: POC load testing (Veridian)

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo this week — our team is ready to run a scaled load validation against your streaming generation APIs. The goal is to validate tail latency and throughput under concurrent sessions before we sign off on the pilot. We estimate roughly 600k tokens of generation over a 48-hour window with spikes to 120 concurrent sessions.

Can Redwood provide a temporary credit top-up or trial extension to support this load? Ideally we can coordinate a 48-72 hour window next week (UTC±0 flexibility). If you need details, I attached the short POC test plan (see veridian_poc_plan.pdf).

Also copying procurement (procurement@veridian.ai) for any billing/contract questions.

Appreciate the help — Jamal

Attachment: veridian_poc_plan.pdf (PDF, 92 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jamal Khan <jamal@veridian.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Top-up request: POC load testing (Veridian)

Hi Jamal — thanks for the plan and details. Looks straightforward from a runtime perspective. A few quick clarifying Qs so we size the credit properly:

- Which endpoints will you hit (chat vs. text generation vs. embeddings)?
- Expected avg tokens per request and average response length?
- Do you need streaming enabled for the load window?

From our side, we can provision a temporary credit top-up. For the numbers you gave (600k tokens, spikes to 120 concurrent), I expect a safe buffer would be 250k–350k extra tokens and a dedicated capacity window to avoid noisy neighbor effects. Provisioning requires approval from my manager and finance for a one-off promotional credit.

I'm looping in Monica (account lead) to start the internal approval and Laura (manager) to sign off. I will send a brief internal note with the POC plan attached.

Next steps:
- Jamal: confirm endpoints and token averages
- Monica: I'll ping for approval path and any terms
- Laura: if you can confirm a one-off 250k token top-up for a 48-hour dedicated window, we can lock a date.

Thanks — Ben

Quoted message: "veridian_poc_plan.pdf attached"

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 11:10:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Top-up request: POC load testing (Veridian)

Forwarding Veridian's request — they want to run a 48-hour load validation with spikes to 120 concurrent sessions. See attached plan.

Key ask: one-off promotional credit top-up and a short dedicated capacity window to ensure consistent latency during the run. Suggested top-up: 250,000 tokens and a 48-hour reserved window (we would bump their tenant to a dedicated burst pool for the test).

Why approve? This is a strategic pilot with clear expansion potential (pipeline stage: POC). If the run proves predictable latency/throughput tradeoffs, Veridian is likely to convert to a Dedicated seat with a quarterly commit.

Requested approvals:
- Sergio: finance — confirm if promotional credit of 250k tokens can be issued under deal RDW-4781 and any billing notes we should include (e.g., auto-cap back to paid post-window).
- Laura: management approval for product/config change to allocate dedicated burst capacity for two days.
- Monica: coordinate schedule and runbook with the Veridian engineering lead.

Attachment: veridian_poc_plan.pdf

2) Apply an expiration: credits valid for the scheduled 48-hour window only; any overage reverts to normal billing at standard rates.
3) Require a short runbook and an on-call owner from Veridian during the test (Monica to collect).

Sergio — please record the promo credit as a non-refundable marketing credit (GL code MKT-PROMO) and add a note in the invoice system that this is conditional on the POC run and not a recurring discount.

Ben — you can confirm with Jamal and schedule the window. Monica — coordinate the technical kickoff and share the runbook link.

Laura
